title: Session Management
description: Manage online duration, concurrent sessions and cleanup policies

enabled.label: Enable Session Management
enabled.desc: When enabled, online duration, concurrent sessions and overflow handling will be restricted.

maxOnlineHours.label: Max Online Duration
maxOnlineHours.desc: Maximum continuous online time per session.

activeTimeoutHours.label: Max Active Duration
activeTimeoutHours.desc: Auto expires after inactivity, 0 means no limit.

concurrentStrategy.label: Concurrent Overflow Strategy
concurrentStrategy.desc: How to handle new sessions when concurrent limit is reached.

concurrentScope.label: Concurrent Counting Scope
concurrentScope.desc: Global: all terminals share one quota pool; Per Device: each terminal type counts independently.
